name: Parallel Octree Data Reduction
aliases: Adaptive multiresolution visualization using parallel octrees
definition: A technique for interactive visualization of large scientific data sets by combining hierarchical data reduction with parallel computing. It distributes data across MPP processors to build a distributed-memory octree, allowing users to interactively adapt resolution (refine or prune) on a local graphics workstation while retaining access to full-resolution data.
summary: Parallel Octree Data Reduction is a parallel computing technique that builds distributed octrees to adaptively subsample large datasets, minimizing approximation error by placing more points where data changes rapidly.
